hypothesis: The saved minKron fast-screen receipts internally support the published selection, continuation comparison, exposure accounting, qualification status and reconstruction bindings.
primary_comparator: The archived report, frozen protocol/addenda, and original verify_run.py; no model comparator is executed.
primary_metric: Count of explicit cross-receipt inconsistencies and unbound required reconstruction inputs.
minimum_useful_effect: Not a performance experiment. One reproducible discrepancy or one meaningful checked obligation is reportable.
success_rule: Reconcile all saved arm/seed/stage identities, scalar summaries and predeclared gates; distinguish matching receipts from missing evidence; reject deliberate inconsistent receipt mutations; preserve the entire completed parent run.
futility_rule: Stop if required evidence cannot be obtained within the workspace and existing public text receipts; report the precise missing dependency. One bounded scope adjustment is allowed and must be recorded.

authorization.user_approval_reference: 2026-10-23 donor request: contribute to Super-1, about 480 minutes, permissions post, at most one focused PR.
authorization.approved_resources: Existing session CPU for read-only standard-library receipt analysis and tests only. No training, inference, model import, checkpoint deserialization, dataset download, cloud resources, paid services or official-test access.
authorization.max_walltime: 480 minutes from 2026-10-23 06:04 UTC; no new investigation after 12:04 UTC; final 120 minutes reserved for verification and handoff.
authorization.local_cpu_budget: Small text/JSON/gzip analyses and bounded corruption tests; no model computation. Expected seconds per audit invocation.

design.original_source_hashes: Bind the parent SOURCE_MANIFEST.json, protocol, addenda, profile, data/tokenizer manifests and directly consumed receipts to the pinned Git base.
design.mechanism_equations: Not modified or executed; numerical claims are checked only against saved qualification rows and frozen tolerances.
design.control_rationale: Run the original repository and run-specific receipt verifiers as positive controls; exercise independent mutations of identities, metrics, counts, status and binding fields as negative controls.
design.seed_selection_method: Parent run's paired seeds; no new experiment seed. Session seed recorded; project has no seeded task picker.
design.learning_rate_trials_per_arm: No new trials; inspect saved schedule accounting only.
design.parameter_counts: Reconcile saved counts without constructing a model.
design.matching_track: E00/E01 evidence and replay readiness; no quality or speed advance claim.
design.compute_accounting: Recompute saved training-second and target-exposure sums; timings are historical receipts, not fresh benchmarks.

data.dataset_versions: Read existing public manifests only; resolve identity and reconstruction links without downloading corpora.
data.tokenizer_sha256: Check the included tokenizer metadata hash against its parent manifest.
data.train_sha256: Metadata binding only; original array bodies are omitted.
data.selection_sha256: Metadata binding only; original array bodies are omitted.
data.confirmation_sha256: Metadata binding only; original array bodies are omitted.
data.split_boundaries: Check saved split metadata and stated document-disjoint/reused-region limitations; no claim of fresh holdout independence.
data.research_wide_region_reuse_audit: Parent explicitly reports reuse from prior work. This audit cannot establish unseen evaluation from scalar receipts.
data.teacher_and_objective: No teacher execution or objective change.

training.updates: No new updates; reconcile saved step sequences.
training.target_exposures_per_trial: Recompute from saved step records and parent batch/context recipe.
training.tokens_per_update: Read the frozen parent budget; require agreement across trajectory and terminal receipts.
training.accessible_history: No capability claim beyond the parent report.
training.precision: Check parent qualification receipts under their existing numerical policy; do not relax tolerances.
training.checkpoint_selection_rule: Recompute the parent development-only selection and distinguish it from reused confirmation.

execution.hardware: Existing sandboxed session CPU, no accelerator use.
execution.runtime_versions: Python standard library only; record version in terminal evidence.
execution.resolved_writable_output: This new run directory and the surrounding donor session folder only.
execution.source_ownership_and_concurrent_writers: Fresh isolated clone. No delegated workers or writes to the completed parent run.
execution.fidelity_tolerances: Use the parent frozen inequalities; scalar recomputation uses math.isclose(rel_tol=1e-12, abs_tol=1e-12), with separately explicit historical printed-rounding checks.
execution.canary_matrix: Unmodified positive fixture plus independent deliberate corruptions of each major checked obligation.
execution.cost_estimate: No install, model execution or large download; bounded standard-library work.

evaluation.primary_endpoint: Machine-readable audit of saved evidence; supported conclusions, mismatches and missing dependencies all retained.
evaluation.canonical_precision: Python binary64 for saved scalar arithmetic; not a new model evaluation.
evaluation.duplicate_policy: Cross-bind the 21 saved first/second confirmation receipts to selected checkpoints; duplicates are repeatability receipts, not independent seeds.
evaluation.uncertainty_method: Recompute descriptive paired means and existing all-seed sign checks only; no new statistical significance or generalization claim.
evaluation.multiple_comparison_policy: Preserve all six screen arms and three continuations; no post-hoc winner or threshold change.

evidence.protocol_sha256: Recorded in the additive run registry entry before analysis; omit self-reference.
evidence.source_manifest: INPUTS.json: exact repository-relative consumed input paths and hashes at the pinned base.
evidence.checkpoint_manifest: Parent metadata only; checkpoint bodies are explicitly not checked.
evidence.progress_path: AUDIT.json and verification log in this new directory
evidence.preservation_policy: Never rewrite archived evidence, prior registry entries or accepted-result status. New evidence and additive audit registration only.
evidence.cleanup_receipt: Record that no unrelated artifacts or workloads were touched.

decision.next_experiment: A precise evidence or replay handoff if this audit identifies one; any model execution requires separate exact authorization.
